title: PAN
text:
Date: **2nd August 1975** should be written as:  
| D  | D  | M  | M  | Y  | Y  | Y  | Y  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| 0  | 2  | 0  | 8  | 1  | 9  | 7  | 5  |  
Relevant date for different categories of applicants is:
**Company:** Date of Incorporation; **Association of Persons:** Date of formation/creation;
**Trusts:** Date of creation of Trust Deed; **Partnership Firms:** Date of Partnership Deed;
**LLPs:** Date of Incorporation/registration; **HUFs:** Date of creation of HUF. [ 3. Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) in the Country of Residence](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#26)
It is a mandatory field. [ 4. Office Address](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#27)
It is a mandatory field. [ 5. Communication Address](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#28)
It is a mandatory field. If the communication address is different from the office address, proof of the communication address must be submitted. PAN card will be dispatched to the communication address. [ 6. Status](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#29)
It is mandatory to select one of the options as applicable. [ 7. Registration Number](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#30)
Registration Number is mandatory for Company and Limited Liability Partnership. [ 8. Contact Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#31)
  1. It is mandatory for the applicants to mention their "Mobile Number" and "e-mail id". 2. Mobile Number should include Country Code and Landline Number (if any) should include STD Code. (i) Mobile Number **9102511111** of India should be written as:
Country Code  
|   | 9  | 1  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
Mobile Number  
| 9  | 1  | 0  | 2  | 5  | 1  | 1  | 1  | 1  | 1  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
Where '91' is the Country Code of India. (ii) Email ID: -
(iii) Landline Number **23555705** of Delhi should be written as: 
STD Code  
|   |   |   | 1  | 1  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
Landline Number  
| 2  | 3  | 5  | 5  | 5  | 7  | 0  | 5  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
Where '11' is the STD Code of Delhi. [ 9. Source of Income](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#32)
It is mandatory to select at least one of the options, as mentioned in the form. In case of multiple sources of income, more than one option can be selected. [ 10. AO Details](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#33)
AO code (Area Code, AO Type, Range Code and AO Number) of the Jurisdictional Assessing Officer must be filled up by the applicant.
